zk.manualDesc: A scored human rules — you, or a ranked adjudicator.
zk.autoDesc: Resolved from a data source, proven by Primus, verified on-chain.
zk.previewIdle: Enter a source URL and a JSON path to preview the value.
zk.previewVerdict: With today's reading this rule resolves {{verdict}}.
zk.scaleHint: Registered once. Readings with more decimals than this are rejected on-chain, so leave headroom.
zk.precisionWarning: The source just returned {{decimals}} decimals, more than the {{scale}} registered. Raise the decimals or this market cannot resolve.
zk.registerFailed: Market launched, but registering the zk adjudicator failed — it resolves manually for now.

gate.loading: Checking whether this deployment allows automatic resolution...
gate.noConfig: Automatic resolution is unavailable: this deployment has no protocol config yet.
gate.readFailed: Could not reach the chain to check whether automatic resolution is allowed here. Reload to try again.
gate.noWallet: Connect a wallet to see whether you may create automatically-resolved markets.
gate.notAuthority: Automatic resolution is permissioned on this deployment. Only the protocol authority ({{authority}}) may register a zk adjudicator; your wallet is not it.

errors.url: Automatic resolution needs a source URL.
errors.urlScheme: The source URL must start with http:// or https://.
errors.path: The JSON path must start with $ — for example $.data.amount.
errors.threshold: Automatic resolution needs a threshold to compare against.
errors.thresholdPrecision: The threshold carries more decimals than the registered scale.

assist.noDrafter: Drafting is unavailable: VITE_AI_DRAFTER_URL is not set. Fill the source in by hand below.
assist.noResolver: Proving is unavailable: VITE_RESOLVER_URL is not set, so this rule cannot be tested against Primus before it is committed.
assist.draftFailed: Drafting failed ({{error}}). Set a source under Advanced.
assist.candidatesHint: Pick one. Nothing is committed until you launch.
assist.attestor: signed by {{address}} — Primus' global attestor, the one this market registers
assist.provenDetail: {{decimals}} decimals, attested in {{seconds}}s. This exact URL and path can be resolved automatically.
assist.proveFailed: Could not reach the proving service ({{error}}). The rule stays unproven.

reasons.fetch: Not proven: the endpoint did not answer with usable JSON, so Primus was never asked.
reasons.response: Not proven: the endpoint answered, but that path does not name a single value in it.
reasons.proxy: Not proven: Primus could not complete an attested TLS session with this endpoint — auth, response size, cipher or proxy behaviour.
reasons.quota: Not proven: Primus refused the request — credentials, or the attestation quota is spent.
reasons.attestor: Not proven: the signature did not come from Primus' global attestor, so the chain would reject it.
reasons.rate_limited: Not proven yet: proving is rate-limited because each attempt spends Primus quota. Try again shortly.
reasons.bad_request: Not proven: the proving service rejected this URL or path.
reasons.unauthorized: Not proven: the proving service needs a token this app was not given.

assist.unprovenWarning: Not proven yet. The rule is committed permanently, so if Primus cannot attest it the market can only be settled by hand.
assist.unprovenAtLaunch: Launching with an UNPROVEN rule — this market may never auto-resolve.
assist.draftingDetail: Finding sources and checking each one returns the value.
assist.timedOut: Drafting gave up after {{seconds}}s. Try again, or fill the source in by hand below.
assist.noneValidated: No source survived checking. Try rewording, or set one under Advanced.
assist.needRule: No rule yet — draft one above, or set one under Advanced.
assist.picked: Using this source. Pick another to swap.
assist.orOwn: Want a different source? Set it under Advanced.
assist.needsAdjudicator: No public data feed can settle this question.
assist.needsAdjudicatorDetail: You can still launch it — it will be settled by a human adjudicator instead of automatically. Switch the resolver under Advanced.

launchpad.questionHint: Ask about a public number with a threshold — a price, rate, index, or count.
launchpad.resolvesEarly: Automatic markets resolve the moment the rule is verifiably met — a satisfied zkTLS attestation locks and attests YES on its own, any time. If it is never met, the deadline reading decides. You can also resolve early by hand from the Locker.

0.desc: Reconciles every USDC in the AMM ledger. Gross Cash is the total pool of assets available to back trades and LP equity.
0.name: Cash Basis Formula

1.desc: The guaranteed minimum value of the pool. Liability is calculated as the cost to pay out the most probable outcome (max shares).
1.name: Equity Floor Formula

2.desc: The real-time redemption value of 1 LP token. Unlike V7, V8 LP tokens are stakeholders in the entire AMM treasury.
2.name: LP Valuation (ExRate)

3.desc: Markets graduate to the SooBook once cumulative trading fees reach 100% of the initial creator deposit (default graduationBps = 10000).
3.name: Graduation Threshold

4.desc: Creator deposit = b × -ln(min(p, 1-p)). At 50/50 odds this simplifies to b × ln(2). Skewed initial odds increase the required deposit.
4.name: Creator Deposit

lp.graduatedHint: In graduated mode, trading fees are split three ways: (1) b-growth increases liquidity depth, (2) LP yield accrues to existing LP holders, and (3) protocol fee. No new LP tokens are minted from trades — your LP share only changes if you bond more LP or redeem.
lp.bondingHint: In bonding mode, every trade you make earns you LP tokens as a reward. The more you trade during bonding, the larger your LP position becomes. Once the market graduates, LP minting stops and your position is locked in. Early traders get the biggest LP allocation.

veto.tipOpen: {{outcome}} has been attested but not settled. This window is the chance to dispute a wrong outcome; when it ends anyone may settle the market.

createdMarkets.title: Markets You Created
createdMarkets.empty: No markets from this wallet yet. Markets are discovered without an index, so only ones this build knows about can appear here.
createdMarkets.attested: Outcome attested — the dispute window has started
createdMarkets.openUntil: Trading until {{date}} — nothing to do yet.
createdMarkets.pastDeadline: Deadline passed {{date}}. Locking is permissionless now and is the step before resolving.
createdMarkets.mayRegister: No adjudicator registered. As creator you may name yourself and then attest the outcome.
createdMarkets.cannotRegister: No adjudicator registered, and this wallet may not register one — permissionless registration is off on this deployment.
createdMarkets.mayAttest: Locked and awaiting an outcome. You hold the attesting key — pick YES, NO or INVALID.
createdMarkets.notAdjudicator: Locked and awaiting the registered adjudicator, which is not this wallet. Nothing to do here.
createdMarkets.orphaned: The adjudicator entry names no key, so nobody may attest. It resolves INVALID through the abandonment hatch.
createdMarkets.inVeto: {{outcome}} attested. Dispute window open — {{time}} until anyone may settle.
createdMarkets.holdsDispute: You hold the dispute veto for this market; disputing is a CLI-only call in this build.
createdMarkets.settleable: {{outcome}} attested and the dispute window has closed. Settlement is permissionless — anyone can crank it.
createdMarkets.initializing: Not activated yet — no curve has been funded.
createdMarkets.openNoAdjudicator: Trading until {{date}}. No adjudicator is registered yet — naming one now is the only step you can take early.
